title: Disappointing but cheap
text: This is a pretty cheap subscription service so that’s not too bad, but the pictures made it seem like there would be at least 4 and maybe 5 products for the lips. I received a lip balm, a chapstick, 1lipstick, and an eyeliner pencil. So for someone who was hoping to get to try out new different lip colors it was pretty disappointing. I don’t need to try eyeliners. And the lipstick I did get was pretty thin in application so I don’t know that any of the products were things I would have bought if I had known what they were gonna be.
label: neutral
